Ravi: rolling out adaptive-quant-cache-batcher v1 to a 10% canary for helix-mid. quick summary below :sparkles:
Jules: awesome — TL;DR numbers?
Ravi: short canary snapshot (live traces + microbench):
``ncanary: 10% traffic
model: helix-mid-4b
p50(before): 65ms -> after: 58ms  (-10.8%)
p95(before): 175ms -> after: 164ms (-6.3%)
p99(before): 420ms -> after: 401ms (-4.5%)
per-token-cost(before): $0.00110 -> after: $0.00096 (-12.7%)
memory: +1.0% (in threshold)
errors/5xx: no increase
``nAisha: nice! any signal on generation quality?
Ravi: ran regression set & sampling checks — top-1 agreement 99.5%, BLEU/ROUGE stable for evals we care about. longer-run evals in progress.
Jules: rollout plan? auto rollback?
Ravi: staged: 10% -> 40% in 1.5h -> 80% in 6h -> 100% in 18h. auto-rollback on: quality drop >1.0% top-1 OR p99 increase >7% OR error-rate >2x. feature flag: runtime.batch.adaptive_quant_cache=true
Oncall-Bot: tagging eng-oncall and eng-sre for the rollout window.
Product-Kate: can we capture the cost delta per-customer tier for next ops review?
Ravi: yes, adding a dashboard card and Cost-by-Customer breakdown.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started by ravi@infra at 2025-05-06T11:12:25Z  job=deploy-helixmid-9031 canary=10%
Aisha: any Dedicated/On-prem work?
Ravi: no changes to API or contracts. Dedicated will have opt-in flag until we certify older drivers.
Jules: please post 24h summary here when done. congrats team :tada:
Ravi: will do. rolling to 40% now.
